Senior Operations Analyst at Northwind Logistics | I turn Excel into clear decisions for operations and supply chain professionals
about_draft:
I am a Senior Operations Analyst in supply chain analytics who helps operations and supply chain professionals make better use of Excel.

What I bring:
• Rebuilt our weekly delivery-performance report as a Power BI dashboard, cutting preparation time from 5 hours to 40 minutes.
• I once presented a cost-saving figure without checking for duplicate shipment IDs; the number was 8% too high until a colleague caught it.
• A 10-minute data check before any review meeting saves hours of damage control.

What I write about: career insights, thought leadership, personal journey, industry trends, actionable tips.
Skills I use most: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Process Improvement, Stakeholder Communication.

Always happy to swap notes. Connect or send me a message.
